description: Send one plain-text message from an address at a domain of the account (send-as must be ready for the domain: see get_send_as). No SMTP login is needed. Links arrive as written; there is no tracking. To answer a message and keep the thread, pass its message_id (from get_logs) as in_reply_to and start the subject with "Re: ". The response has the message_id; get_logs with direction out shows what each recipient's server answered. Each recipient counts against the plan's send limit. Pass idempotency_key when a retry must not send a second copy.

cc.description: Copy recipients, shown in the message

copy_to_owner.description: Also send a hidden copy to the account's own address

from.description: The sender, for example "Ada <ada@example.com>". The domain must be one of the account.

idempotency_key.description: The same key twice sends once and returns the first response

in_reply_to.description: The message_id of the message this one answers

references.description: Older message ids of the thread, oldest first; defaults to in_reply_to

reply_to.description: Where replies go, when not the sender

name: send_email
title: Send an email
